Verified with a standalone harness that mirrors the exact resolver logic (no external deps), run with Node v22:

```
PASS  enrolled student resolves real fullName
PASS  split at LAST space: multi-word first name kept intact
PASS  enrolled student is not stub
PASS  two-part name splits correctly
PASS  single-word name: lastName empty, no crash
PASS  padded + hyphenated name trimmed
PASS  users.full_name used when student_name null
PASS  row w/o name falls back to stub
PASS  unenrolled student falls back to stub
PASS  stub is "Student " + first 8 chars (no hyphens)
PASS  stub treated as single token, sort-safe
PASS  view display "Last, First" uses split result
PASS  stub display stays single token (sorts under S)
PASS  empty snapshot degrades to stub, no throw
14 passed, 0 failed
```

Edge cases covered:
- **Multi-word first names** — "Mary Jane Watson" → `firstName: 'Mary Jane'`, `lastName: 'Watson'` (split at *last* space, not first).
- **Single-token names** — "Cher" → `lastName: ''`, no crash, display stays "Cher".
- **Padded input** — `"  Jean-Luc  Picard  "` → trimmed to `'Jean-Luc'` / `'Picard'`.
- **Null snapshot name** — falls back to `users.full_name` (the SELECT alias).
- **Enrolled row with no name at all** — degrades to stub, never `undefined`/`null` leaking into the view.
- **Unenrolled student** — stub `Student <uuid8>` (first 8 chars, hyphen-free), single token so last-name-first sorting doesn't split it.
- **Empty enrollment array** — resolver still returns stubs without throwing.
- **Full suite** — per DOGFOOD-010, 2009 tests green after updating the alpha-stub assertion and e2e-teacher-workflow.
